mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases cost of capital for corporations, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 over the 5-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals imminent economic contraction, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0% and INDPRO growth rate < 0%
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth rates are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25% per month) increase borrowing costs and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% per month.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 210.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank tightening, reducing real earnings and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210.0.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls below 138000 (thousands) signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 138000.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS growth rate < 0%) combined with FEDFUNDS above 4.0% signals weak consumer demand and tight monetary policy, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: demand contraction with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 110 (index) indicates supply contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 110.
